description: We are a passionate team of four united by a shared obsession with space exploration, cutting-edge technology, and creative problem-solving. Blending diverse skills in software development, data analysis, and innovative design, we thrive on transforming complex, real-world space data into intuitive, impactful solutions. For the NASA Space Apps Challenge, we aren't just building a project—we are pushing the boundaries of what a small, dedicated team can achieve when curiosity meets execution.
